import openpyxl
p='seed_collection_0084_inconsistent_color_7658_input.xlsx'
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p)
for ws in wb.worksheets:
    print('SHEET', ws.title, ws.dimensions)
    # collect unique fill colors with counts and examples
    from collections import defaultdict
    counts=defaultdict(int)
    examples={}
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for c in row:
            fg=c.fill.fgColor.rgb if c.fill and c.fill.fgColor else None
            bg=c.fill.bgColor.rgb if c.fill and c.fill.bgColor else None
            key=(fg,bg,c.fill.patternType)
            counts[key]+=1
            if key not in examples:
                examples[key]=(c.coordinate,c.value)
    for k,v in counts.items():
        print(v, k, examples[k])
PY
